arrives.text: A vampire comes near your village

lodge_built.text: Build the lodge: the altar and two workbenches in one room

scene01_meeting.note: Scene 1. Best with a vampire killed nearby (made_kill), else the cold-trail opening.

scene02_wolf.note: Founds the lodge order and gives the founder a wolf.

scene03_altar.note: Place the Oath Altar you got when the lodge was founded.

scene05_volunteers.note: Needs a resident adult (athletic or confident) with a young child, or the name is blank.

scene07_walk.note: You must be sworn into the lodge for the walk to be offered normally.

scene08_watch.note: Brings real vampires in. Needs night, and the lodge to have a sworn hunter.

m2_midwife.note: The midwife arrives at your village shortly (Persona arrival).

wounded.note: Brings the court's vampires in. Best at night, with the wolf around.

m4_book.note: Gives you the Book of Oaths.

midpoint.note: The candle-bringer walks in; talk to the founder again with them near.

confession_after.note: Plays the founder's side after a forgiven confession.

scene14_debrief.note: Scene 14. A debrief after a kill; lines follow the pull of the blood.

scene15_stakeout.note: Scene 15. Uses a resident vampire who never bit anyone (from scene 9), else a settler walks in. The nights need late_night talks on different days.

scene16_willing.note: Scene 16. A vampire and their thrall walk in; talk again once they are near.

scene17_fledgling.note: Scene 17. A fledgling walks in; talk again once they are near. The cure goes through the midwife.

act3_inside.note: Wolf beat 12, the start of Act 3: its bed moves inside.

act3_court_offer.note: Act 3. Hands you a map to the father's house and walks with you.

act3_court.note: Act 3 at the court, wherever you stand: brings the father and the quiet one up beside you. Talk again for the pivot. Set blood_pull to try either ending.
